items.headline: NASA Calls Off Rescue Mission for Swift Space Telescope
items.summary: On August 19, 2026, NASA and private startup Katalyst Space Technologies officially called off a planned rescue mission for the aging Swift space telescope [1.1.1]. The decision means the historic observatory will not have its orbit raised and is now doomed to a fiery atmospheric reentry later this year.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy Warns LIV Golf Defectors Face Tough Path Back to PGA Tour
items.summary: Ahead of the BMW Championship, Rory McIlroy questioned the value top stars like Jon Rahm brought to LIV Golf as the breakaway league faces major financial uncertainty. McIlroy warned that defecting players hoping to rejoin the PGA Tour will face a difficult, penalty-laden path back rather than an immediate welcome.

items.headline: Leaked Grand Theft Auto VI Gameplay Videos Surface Online Ahead of Official Reveal
items.summary: A hacker group leaked multiple unreleased Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay videos and map images online, displaying features like vehicle driving, mini-games, and combat mechanics. Publisher Take-Two Interactive quickly issued copyright takedowns to remove the footage, making it a major story just days before an official showcase event.
